pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# TwinWorld Challenge 2026

**TwinWorld Challenge 2026** is the official challenge of the [TwinWorld Workshop](https://twin-world.github.io/) at **ECCV 2026** (8 September 2026, Malmö, Sweden).

## Challenge Task

**Large-Scale 3D Semantic Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction**

The challenge targets large-scale drone imagery and semantic neural reconstruction on two datasets: **TUM** (TUM2TWIN) and **Gold Coast**. Participants are asked to:

1. **Novel view synthesis** — render photorealistic RGB images from the provided camera poses (all scenes).
2. **3D geometric reconstruction** — reconstruct a 3D point cloud of the scene (evaluated on TUM scenes).
3. **3D semantic segmentation** — assign one of 5 semantic class labels (ground, wall, roof, window, other) to each point of the reconstructed point cloud (evaluated on Gold Coast scenes).

## Timeline

| Milestone | Date |
|-----------|------|
| Development phase opens | 04 Aug 2026 |
| Final phase opens | 20 Aug 2026 |
| Final phase closes | 1 Sep 2026 |
| Results presented at workshop | 8 Sep 2026 |

## Workshop

The challenge results will be presented at the **TwinWorld @ ECCV 2026** workshop session (09:30, 8 Sep 2026).

The workshop focuses on scalable 3D and 4D scene understanding, multimodal reconstruction, semantic scene graphs, and real-world digital twin applications for autonomous driving, construction monitoring, and robotics.

## Challenge Organizers

Olaf Wysocki;
Qilin Zhang;
Chenghao Qian 

See the [TwinWorld website](https://twin-world.github.io/) for the full organizing committee @ CV4DT University of Cambridge.

# TwinWorld Challenge 2026

**TwinWorld Challenge 2026** 是 **ECCV 2026**（2026年9月8日，瑞典马尔默）上 [TwinWorld Workshop](https://twin-world.github.io/) 的官方挑战赛。

## 挑战任务

**大规模3D语义高斯泼溅重建**

该挑战赛针对两个数据集上的大规模无人机影像和语义神经重建：**TUM**（TUM2TWIN）和**黄金海岸**。参赛者需要完成以下任务：

1. **新视角合成** — 从提供的相机位姿渲染逼真的RGB图像（所有场景）。
2. **3D几何重建** — 重建场景的3D点云（在TUM场景上进行评估）。
3. **3D语义分割** — 为重建点云的每个点分配5个语义类别标签之一（地面、墙壁、屋顶、窗户、其他）（在黄金海岸场景上进行评估）。

| 研讨会成果展示 | 2026年9月8日 |

挑战赛结果将在 **TwinWorld @ ECCV 2026** 研讨会（2026年9月8日 09:30）上展示。

该研讨会重点关注可扩展3D和4D场景理解、多模态重建、语义场景图，以及用于自动驾驶、施工监测和机器人技术的现实数字孪生应用。

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation

## Submission Format

Participants submit a **zip file** with the following structure (zip the dataset folders directly, without an extra top-level folder):

```
submission.zip
├── tum/
│   └── <scene_id>/
│       ├── rgb/
│       │   ├── <frame_id>.png      # rendered novel views, one per reference frame
│       │   └── ...
│       └── 3D_point_cloud/
│           └── point_cloud.ply     # x, y, z (float)
└── gold_coast/
    └── <scene_id>/
        ├── rgb/
        │   └── <frame_id>.png
        └── 3D_point_cloud/
            └── point_cloud.ply     # x, y, z (float) + classification (uchar)
```

- `rgb/` — rendered images, **PNG**, exactly the same resolution and frame IDs (file name stems) as the reference frames provided for each scene.
- `3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply` — the reconstructed point cloud. `x, y, z` are always required. The `classification` property (integer, one of the 5 class indices below or 255 = ignore) is required **only for Gold Coast scenes**.
- Scene IDs and frame IDs must **exactly match** those in the starting kit. A submission missing any required file is rejected without being scored (`incomplete_submission`).

## Semantic Classes (Gold Coast)

| Index | Class |
|-------|-------|
| 0 | ground |
| 1 | wall |
| 2 | roof |
| 3 | window |
| 4 | other |
| 255 | ignore (excluded from scoring) |

## Metrics

**2D rendering (all scenes):**

| Metric | Description | Direction |
|--------|-------------|-----------|
| **PSNR** | Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio on rendered RGB images | ↑ |
| **SSIM** | Structural Similarity Index (Wang et al., Gaussian-weighted) | ↑ |
| **LPIPS** | Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (VGG) | ↓ |

**3D geometry (TUM scenes only):** GT and submitted point clouds are cropped to the GT bounding box (+20 cm padding) and voxel-downsampled at 2 cm; then precision/recall **F-scores at 5 cm, 10 cm, and 20 cm** are computed. The reported `F-score` is the mean of the three.

**3D semantics (Gold Coast scenes only):** each GT point takes the label of the nearest submitted point within 10 cm (unmatched points count as errors). Per-class IoU is pooled over all scenes; **mIoU 3D** is the mean over the 5 classes.

## Final Score & Ranking

The leaderboard is ranked by **Final Score** (descending):

```
rendering_score = mean(PSNR / 50 capped at 1,  SSIM,  1 − LPIPS)   # in [0, 1]
geometry_score  = mean(F-score @ 5 cm, 10 cm, 20 cm)               # in [0, 1]
semantic_score  = mIoU 3D                                           # in [0, 1]

Final Score = rendering_score + geometry_score + semantic_score     # in [0, 3]
```

Higher is better; the maximum Final Score is **3.0**.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估

## 提交格式

参赛者需提交一个 **zip 文件**，结构如下（直接压缩数据集文件夹，不包含额外的顶层文件夹）：

```
submission.zip
├── tum/
│   └── <scene_id>/
│       ├── rgb/
│       │   ├── <frame_id>.png      # 渲染的新视图，每个参考帧一张
│       │   └── ...
│       └── 3D_point_cloud/
│           └── point_cloud.ply     # x, y, z (float)
└── gold_coast/
    └── <scene_id>/
        ├── rgb/
        │   └── <frame_id>.png
        └── 3D_point_cloud/
            └── point_cloud.ply     # x, y, z (float) + classification (uchar)
```

- `rgb/` — 渲染的图像，**PNG 格式**，分辨率和帧 ID（文件名）必须与每个场景提供的参考帧完全相同。
- `3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply` — 重建的点云。`x, y, z` 始终需要。`classification` 属性（整数，为下面的 5 个类索引之一或 255 = 忽略）**仅对 Gold Coast 场景需要**。
- 场景 ID 和帧 ID 必须**完全匹配**起始工具包中的内容。提交缺少任何必需文件的结果将被拒绝，不计入评分（`incomplete_submission`）。

## 语义类别（Gold Coast）

| 索引 | 类别 |
|------|------|
| 0 | 地面 |
| 1 | 墙壁 |
| 2 | 屋顶 |
| 3 | 窗户 |
| 4 | 其他 |
| 255 | 忽略（排除在评分外） |

## 指标

**2D 渲染（所有场景）：**

| 指标 | 描述 | 方向 |
|------|------|------|
| **PSNR** | 渲染 RGB 图像的峰值信噪比 | ↑ |
| **SSIM** | 结构相似度指数（Wang 等人，高斯加权） | ↑ |
| **LPIPS** | 学习感知图像块相似度（VGG） | ↓ |

**3D 几何（仅 TUM 场景）：** 真实值点云和提交的点云都裁剪到真实值边界框（+20 厘米填充）并以 2 厘米体素下采样；然后计算精确度/召回率 **F-分数（5 厘米、10 厘米、20 厘米）**。报告的 `F-score` 是三个值的平均值。

**3D 语义（仅 Gold Coast 场景）：** 每个真实值点取最近的提交点（10 厘米内）的标签；未匹配的点计为错误。按类别计算 IoU 并在所有场景上汇总；**mIoU 3D** 是 5 个类别的平均值。

## 最终分数与排名

排行榜按 **Final Score**（最终分数）降序排列：

```
rendering_score = mean(PSNR / 50 上限为 1,  SSIM,  1 − LPIPS)   # 范围 [0, 1]
geometry_score  = mean(F-score @ 5 cm, 10 cm, 20 cm)            # 范围 [0, 1]
semantic_score  = mIoU 3D                                        # 范围 [0, 1]

Final Score = rendering_score + geometry_score + semantic_score  # 范围 [0, 3]
```

分数越高越好；最高最终分数为 **3.0**。

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
# Data

## Datasets

The challenge uses two large-scale drone imagery datasets:

- **TUM** ([TUM2TWIN](https://tum2t.win/)) — urban scenes; evaluated on **2D rendering + 3D geometry**.
- **Gold Coast** ([GT-LOD3 Benchmark](https://github.com/gdslab/GT-LOD3-Benchmark), [Gold Coast subset](https://stac.d2s.org/collections/ee10a5c0-2554-44e5-b59f-81eedfe02eb6?.language=en)) — coastal urban scenes; evaluated on **2D rendering + 3D semantic segmentation** (5 classes).

Full dataset access details are announced via the [TwinWorld Dataset website](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zqlin/TwinWorld_Datasets).

## Starting Kit

The[ starting kit](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zqlin/TwinWorld_Datasets/tree/main/starting_kit) is included with the dataset on Hugging Face, under `starting_kit/`. It contains:

- `README.md` — the submission format description, plus a set of reference Gaussian Splatting implementations to use as a starting point.
- `make_dummy_submission.py` — script that generates a correctly structured (random-content) submission zip for pipeline testing

## Submission Format

A single **zip file**, containing the dataset folders at the top level:

```
submission.zip
├── tum/<scene_id>/
│   ├── rgb/<frame_id>.png
│   └── 3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply         # x, y, z
└── gold_coast/<scene_id>/
    ├── rgb/<frame_id>.png
    └── 3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply         # x, y, z, classification
```

- Scene IDs and frame IDs (file name stems) must **exactly match** the reference frames provided for each phase.
- `rgb/` images must be PNG at exactly the reference resolution.
- Point clouds must be valid PLY with finite `x, y, z` coordinates. Binary little-endian PLY with `float32` coordinates is recommended to keep uploads small; store only the properties listed above (no colors/normals — they are ignored by the scorer and inflate the upload).
- Gold Coast point clouds additionally require an integer `classification` property with values in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 255}.

## Semantic Classes

5 evaluated classes: `0 ground, 1 wall, 2 roof, 3 window, 4 other`; `255` = ignore (excluded from scoring).
pages.content_zh:
# 数据

## 数据集

本赛事使用两个大规模无人机影像数据集：

- **TUM** ([TUM2TWIN](https://tum2t.win/)) — 城市场景；评估指标为 **2D渲染 + 3D几何**。
- **黄金海岸** ([GT-LOD3基准](https://github.com/gdslab/GT-LOD3-Benchmark)、[黄金海岸子集](https://stac.d2s.org/collections/ee10a5c0-2554-44e5-b59f-81eedfe02eb6?.language=en)) — 沿海城市场景；评估指标为 **2D渲染 + 3D语义分割**（5个类别）。

完整数据集访问详情通过 [TwinWorld数据集网站](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zqlin/TwinWorld_Datasets) 发布。

## 开始工具包

[开始工具包](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zqlin/TwinWorld_Datasets/tree/main/starting_kit) 包含在Hugging Face的数据集中，路径为 `starting_kit/`。其中包括：

- `README.md` — 提交格式说明，以及可作为起点的一组参考高斯喷溅实现。
- `make_dummy_submission.py` — 用于生成结构正确的（随机内容）提交zip文件的脚本，用于流程测试

## 提交格式

单个 **zip文件**，在顶层包含数据集文件夹：

```
submission.zip
├── tum/<scene_id>/
│   ├── rgb/<frame_id>.png
│   └── 3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply         # x, y, z
└── gold_coast/<scene_id>/
    ├── rgb/<frame_id>.png
    └── 3D_point_cloud/point_cloud.ply         # x, y, z, classification
```

- 场景ID和帧ID（文件名主干）必须 **完全匹配** 各阶段提供的参考帧。
- `rgb/` 图像必须为PNG格式且分辨率 **完全匹配** 参考分辨率。
- 点云必须为有效的PLY格式，包含有限的 `x, y, z` 坐标。建议使用二进制小端序PLY格式，坐标采用 `float32` 以减小上传体积；仅存储上述属性（不包含颜色/法线——评分器会忽略这些属性且会增加上传体积）。
- 黄金海岸点云另需包含整数型 `classification` 属性，值范围为 {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 255}。

## 语义类别

5个评估类别：`0 地面, 1 墙体, 2 屋顶, 3 窗户, 4 其他`；`255` = 忽略（在评分中排除）。

pages.title: Terms
pages.content:
# Terms and Conditions

By participating in TwinWorld Challenge 2026, you agree to the following terms:

1. **Data usage** — The provided TUM2TWIN dataset may only be used for the purposes of this challenge.
2. **Submission limit** — Participants are limited to 3 submissions per day during the Development phase and 1 per day during the Final phase (max 10 total).
3. **Code sharing** — Top-ranked participants may be required to share their code for verification before being listed on the final leaderboard.
4. **Fair play** — Any attempt to manipulate the leaderboard or use external ground-truth data will result in disqualification.
5. **Publication** — Results may be presented at the TwinWorld Workshop @ ECCV 2026 (8 Sep 2026, Malmö, Sweden).

For questions, contact the organizers at okw24@cam.ac.uk ; qilin.zhang@kit.edu; yohji.qian@gmail.com
pages.content_zh:
# 条款和条件

参加TwinWorld Challenge 2026即表示您同意以下条款：

1. **数据使用** — 提供的TUM2TWIN数据集仅可用于本竞赛目的。
2. **提交限制** — 参赛者在开发阶段每天限制提交3次，在最终阶段每天限制1次（总计最多10次）。
3. **代码共享** — 排名靠前的参赛者可能需要共享其代码以供验证，方可列入最终排行榜。
4. **公平竞争** — 任何操纵排行榜或使用外部真值数据的行为将导致取消资格。
5. **成果发表** — 结果可在TwinWorld Workshop @ ECCV 2026（2026年9月8日，瑞典马尔默）上呈现。

如有任何问题，请联系组织者：okw24@cam.ac.uk；qilin.zhang@kit.edu；yohji.qian@gmail.com
